items.title: WebSocket and server-sent event sessions
items.scope: Add long-lived HTTP workspace sessions while preserving secret handling and desktop network protections.

items.title: Cross-language notebook dataflow
items.scope: Let notebook cells react to values produced by another language without making execution implicit or opaque.

items.title: Integrated terminal
items.scope: A project-scoped desktop terminal designed for the same local-first security model as native runners.

items.title: Project test runner
items.scope: Desktop now detects Vitest, Jest, Pytest, Go, and Cargo behind the approved project root, streams bounded output, and owns stop and timeout without invoking a shell.

items.title: Faster cold browser startup
items.scope: Language tokenizers already load on demand; remaining editor integrations are being isolated so Monaco core can leave the initial bundle.

items.title: Reliable multi-file projects
items.scope: Project tree, native search, replace, curated templates, binary-safe bundle import/export, and isolated template runtime smoke ship today.

items.title: Complete CLI distribution
items.scope: Utility commands, execution, Capsule replay, completions, and stable errors ship today. The release pipeline now produces a minimal npm package plus validated Windows/Linux standalone archives and signs Windows after SEA injection when credentials exist; registry promotion and public-trust credentials remain operational gates.

items.title: Version-to-version migration coverage
items.scope: Capsules have an explicit migration registry, distinct newer-app guidance, and an automated journey that carries an immutable v0.15.0 artifact through the current shared parser, renderer importer, CLI replay, and web UI.

items.title: Deeper debugging controls
items.scope: JavaScript and TypeScript breakpoints, stepping, bounded watch evaluation, conditional breakpoints, and non-pausing logpoints ship today in web and desktop. Python UI integration remains desktop-only product work on top of the existing engine.

items.title: Multi-file import and sharing
items.scope: Share links, Capsules, bounded TypeScript and Go Playground migration, cURL, Postman, Bruno files and collection folders, Jupyter notebooks, and native notebooks ship today. Capsule Workspaces add a privacy-first multi-file viewer with explicit open-tab selection and no backend.
